function.name: react
function.description: React to the current WhatsApp message with one emoji. Use this in groups when the message is funny, hype, grateful, cute, shocked, or otherwise reaction-worthy. Call it before you answer. Then still send a normal text reply. Do not mention the reaction in your reply.

emoji.description: A single emoji. Examples: laughing face, fire, red heart, thumbs up, folded hands, surprised face, thinking face, party, waving hand, hundred points.
